name: Sight the Quarry
text: Every hunt begins by choosing which thing dies. For 1 AP, name one creature you can see as your Quarry; you know its exact position for as long as it shares a plane with you, through cover, darkness, or concealment. Cover and Concealment never Downgrade your Impact Rolls against your Quarry. The mark lasts until the Quarry is reduced to 0 Hit Points, until you name another, or until the combat ends.

name: Predator's Patience
text: You are paid for waiting. The first time each round that you hit your Quarry, or hit a creature that cannot see you, you gain 1 Momentum.

name: Ambush Predator
text: The shot that matters is the one nobody braced for. For 1 AP and 1 Agility Point, make one attack against your Quarry and add one Agility Die to its Impact Roll. If your Quarry cannot see you, or has not yet acted this combat, add two Agility Dice instead.

name: Apex Predator
text: Nothing you have named gets to pick the distance. As a Reaction when your Quarry moves, spend 1 Momentum to move up to your Speed toward it. This movement ignores difficult terrain and provokes no Opportunity Attacks.

name: Pack Leader
text: You teach the others to read the mark the way you do. Your allies' Impact Rolls against your Quarry are never Downgraded by Cover or Concealment. Once each round, when an ally hits your Quarry, spend 1 Agility Point to give that ally 1 Momentum.

name: Pack Frenzy
text: Three hunters working one animal is not three attacks; it is a collapse. Whenever three or more different creatures attack your Quarry in the same round, its Vigor Defense is Sundered by 1 for the remainder of the combat.

name: Shroud Step
text: Vanishing is a matter of reading sightlines, not of finding a shadow. For 1 AP and 1 Agility Point, you become Hidden, with no cover or darkness required. Any enemy that locates you Downgrades its Impact Dice against you until you attack or cast a spell.

name: Coordinated Strike
text: Requires any two Hunt Majors. Your pack opens the wound and you are already inside it. As a Reaction when an ally hits your Quarry, spend 2 Momentum and 1 Agility Point to make one attack against that Quarry, adding one Agility Die to its Impact Roll. You may do this once each round.

name: One With the Wastes
text: You stop being something the wastes hide and start being something they answer to. You move at full speed while Hidden, and attacking your Quarry does not reveal you. Once per combat, when your Quarry is reduced to 0 Hit Points, spend 1 Agility Point to fill your Momentum to its cap and name a new Quarry with no action.
